---
title: "Where does the ballast go, and how much?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

The neutral point from a straight-line fit of `Cm` against `CL` over α = 0–8° at
6 m/s, then the ballast mass that puts the CG the required static margin ahead
of it.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Specified
**Static margin: 10% MAC** · asked of the user, 2026-08-27 · a conventional
free-flight value, leaving margin for build warp without making the glider
sluggish. The plan does not specify one, so it is a design decision rather than
something the model could derive.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Assumed
The fit band for the neutral point, α = 0–8°. That is a modelling convention
rather than a design choice — it brackets the best-L/D angle.
:::

```{python}
mp0 = mass_properties()
x_np = neutral_point(band=(0, 8), V=6.0)

SM = 0.10                            # specified above
x_cg = x_np - SM * c_w

x_b = np.linspace(0, x_le_w, 200)
m_b = ballast_for(x_cg, x_b, mp0)
nose, le = ballast_for(x_cg, 0.0, mp0), ballast_for(x_cg, x_le_w, mp0)

DIME = 2.268e-3                      # kg, a US dime, the plan's own ballast
dime = mass_properties(m_ballast=DIME, x_ballast=0.0)
```

**Answer.** On the nose, and `{python} f"{nose*1e3:.2f}"` g of it. Unballasted
the airframe is unstable — `{python} f"{mp0.mass*1e3:.2f}"` g of foam puts the
CG `{python} f"{mp0.x_cg*1e3:.1f}"` mm aft of the nose against a neutral point
at `{python} f"{x_np*1e3:.1f}"` mm, a static margin of
`{python} f"{static_margin(mp0.x_cg, x_np)*100:+.0f}"`% MAC — because a
stabilizer `{python} f"{S_h/S_w*100:.0f}"`% the area of the wing, plus the fin,
sit at the end of a `{python} f"{l_fus*100:.1f}"` cm fuselage.

Station matters more than the mass does: the same
`{python} f"{SM*100:.0f}"`% costs `{python} f"{nose*1e3:.2f}"` g at the nose but
`{python} f"{le*1e3:.2f}"` g at the wing leading edge (@fig-ballast), where the
plan says to tape the dime. A dime alone is not enough at this size;
`{python} f"{DIME*1e3:.2f}"` g on the nose lands the CG at
`{python} f"{dime.x_cg*1e3:.1f}"` mm, `{python} f"{(x_np - dime.x_cg)*1e3:.1f}"`
mm ahead of the neutral point, which is under half a percent of MAC and stable
in name only.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ballast
#| fig-cap: "Ballast mass needed against the station it is taped to, from the nose back to the wing leading edge, for the specified 10% MAC. The dashed line marks the 2.27 g of the dime the plan calls for."
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))

ax.plot(x_b * 1e3, m_b * 1e3, label=f"static margin {SM:.0%} MAC")
ax.axhline(DIME * 1e3, ls="--", c="0.4", lw=1,
           label=f"a dime, {DIME*1e3:.2f} g")
ax.set_xlabel("ballast station [mm aft of the nose]")
ax.set_ylabel("ballast mass [g]")
ax.set_xlim(0, x_le_w * 1e3)
ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
